name: CalmDown_3
short_caption: The robot gently raises both hands with palms facing down and pushes downward to signal calming or slowing down.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing position and lifts both arms forward with bent elbows, turning its palms downward and spreading its fingers slightly. It then performs a small, controlled downward pressing motion with both hands, accompanied by a slight tilt of the head. Finally, the robot lowers its arms smoothly back to its sides, returning to the neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The robot's arms extend slightly forward, requiring minimal clearance in front of the chest.
